sentences: I measure the width of the road with a tape measure every morning.
I check the painted lines for fading and note where they need repainting.
I count the number of cars passing a fixed point during rush hour.
I install new reflective markers along the edge of the highway every spring.
I fill potholes with cold patch and tamp the asphalt down using a hand tamper.
I sweep the gravel off the shoulder with a rotary broom after the winter.
I spread salt on the icy surface before the morning commute starts.
I inspect the expansion joints on the bridge for cracks every quarter.
I collect the toll at the booth and hand back change to drivers.
I adjust the timing of the traffic signals at the intersection during peak hours.
I repaint the crosswalk stripes with white thermoplastic before the school year begins.
I tighten the bolts on the guardrail posts after a collision is reported.
I clear the ditch of leaves and debris so water can flow.
I check the culvert for blockages after heavy rain storms pass through.
I replace the stop sign that was knocked down by wind gusts.
I read the mile marker posts to track my location along the route.
I pull into the rest area to check the trash cans for overflow.
I weigh trucks at the station on the interstate every weekday morning.
I drive the route to survey the road surface condition each month.
I record the pavement roughness index with a profilometer on the highway every year.
